items.q: And even in Pittsburgh, we had one of the TOBA theaters. And we saw all those acts, too. Mamie Smith, Bessie Smith, Ma Rainey -- they played Pittsburgh.

ctx.x: And even in Pittsburgh, we had one of the TOBA theaters. And we saw all those acts, too.
Mamie Smith, Bessie Smith, Ma Rainey -- they played Pittsburgh.
We had a theater in Pittsburgh, the Elmore Theater, which all the black acts played there.
